description: This source file defines the ValidatorActionFilter class, which implements an ASP.NET Core IActionFilter to perform model validation and return validation errors as JSON responses when model state is invalid.

classes.name: ValidatorActionFilter
classes.description: A filter that checks the validity of the model state before executing an action, returning a JSON-formatted list of errors with HTTP status 422 if invalid.

methods.name: OnActionExecuting
methods.description: Called before the action executes; performs validation, and if invalid, constructs and returns a JSON error response with status code 422.
